div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p: 期望库授权与快照回调

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
关口进入 snapshotting
拒绝新租约、撤销旧租约

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
关闭全部工作组
等待真实任务、读取和资源退出

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
复核持久库授权
代次不变且没有 pending

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
执行并等待快照回调
存储适配器另持有写入屏障

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
成功或导出失败后
再次复核权威与关口状态

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
恢复 ready
宿主创建新的普通工作组

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
保持 uncertain
关闭并重新组装

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
请求协作取消
等待实际快照任务退出

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
closed
绝不重新开放接纳
